decisions.reason: A space navigation and observation camera with its own website page fits the firm's established space optics portfolio, and space products have long qualification cycles that justify keeping them on the market.
The modular navigation camera is prominently presented and builds on reusable heritage designs, so it is likely to stay as a core offering for satellite customers.
Demand for space situational awareness is growing in European defense and space programs, so the firm is likely to keep developing and marketing the sensor suite.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, which suggests it is at an earlier or lower-priority stage, but space programs are long-term and a large firm would probably keep it while seeking first customers.
